sources.title: AAU-NLP/Pre-BERT-SL1000 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Pre-BERT-SL1000 is a BERT-based sequence labeling model fine-tuned on the HiFi-KPI dataset for extracting financial key performance indicators (KPIs) from SEC earnings filings (10-K & 10-Q). It specializes in identifying entities, such as revenue, earnings, etc.
